title: Design: New Matrix from a category's page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Click New Matrix.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page shows New Matrix at the top right.

Step 3:

  • A New Matrix page opens; its Categories box reads "Categories (1)" with category A in it.
  • The breadcrumb reads Settings › Categories › category A's name › New Matrix, with a large empty "Matrix name" field, Cancel and a blue Create Matrix, as in picture 7.13.
